claim: Two completed exact-compatible scenario rerun queues can be compared through a deterministic neutral response matrix and exported as a bounded independently verifiable open JSON artifact.
verified: Comparison requires distinct completed jobs with identical project, document, prompt version, scenario IDs, and byte-exact scenario revisions
Rows are canonically ordered by stable scenario ID and derive a nine-cell handled/unhandled/uncertain transition matrix without improvement or truth labels
The artifact retains both verified immutable policy snapshots, exact scenario revisions, full evaluation evidence, and route/model/run/attempt/author attribution
Unavailable model hash, sampler, and seed metadata are explicit nulls with a nondeterminism warning rather than silently omitted
Policy-version, scenario-revision, and complete-artifact SHA-256 values are recomputed during decode
Decoder rejects unknown fields, tampering, noncanonical order, mismatched redundant identities/routes/results, inconsistent executed-model sets, timestamps, change flags, and summaries
The published strict Draft 2020-12 schema validates the real typed fixture while documenting semantic checks that require the runtime verifier
Product controls show responsive side-by-side response, rationale, uncertainty, model, and run evidence and disclose every research body written by explicit export
Comparison uses no model, key, network, or shared mutation; MCP research-state inspection exposes only compatible-pair count
limitations: No semantic, causal, correctness, improvement, consensus, or model-quality claim is made from an outcome transition.
Model binary hash, sampler settings, and seed were not captured by P-30 and therefore cannot be reconstructed by P-31.
Researcher identity and timestamps are installation/caller supplied and are not authenticated or trusted across installs.
No live paid-provider repeatability or nondeterminism benchmark is included.
No packaged OS Save-dialog or two-physical-install comparison interaction is included.
The export intentionally contains sensitive policy, scenario, response, rationale, and uncertainty bodies; destination choice remains the researcher's responsibility.
